shortDescription: Russia’s giant Vostok Oil project in the Taimyr region has loaded its first crude for shipment via the Northern Sea Route, according to Bloomberg.The move expands Russia’s presence in the Arctic and opens the way for future growth in oil production.

title: GEOPOLITICS | Russia’s Vostok Oil Ships First Crude on Arctic Tanker
